Proposal: 75–90 minute technical ops runthrough (ML/Infra + Security + Procurement optional)

2) 20–30 min — architecture walkthrough: model + infra + data flow (your team)
3) 25–30 min — Redwood demo: serving runtime, batching/kv caching, quantization variants (live perf/latency numbers)
4) 15–20 min — security/compliance + next steps / mutual action plan

Availability asks

  - Tue Nov 26, 2029 10:00–11:30 PST
  - Thu Nov 28, 2029 14:00–15:30 PST

If neither works, share three 60–90 min options and we’ll coordinate. I’ve CC’d Marissa (SE) and Ben (infra) who will lead the session on our side. We can attach a short agenda and mutual action plan once you confirm.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.
